name: How a flow renders in the Atlas
summary: Atlas walks stored flow JSON, resolves live AC status while normalizing each record, and sends serializable props to its graph view. It does not read product-truth index.json for this path.

steps.label: Resolve each step to its AC's live work_status
steps.human:
parseStep and parseBranch resolve implements IDs through acById, then derive each implStatus from live workStatus. Unresolved IDs retain the stored fallback; no linked ACs means not_started. These are internal loader records. [Resolution](leafcutter-web/lib/data/flows.ts) uses the [AC loader](leafcutter-web/lib/data/ac-store.ts); it does not rewrite the source ACs.

Contract fields and examples (generated)
Consumes:
  raw_flow/steps/*/id: string (required)
  raw_flow/steps/*/implements: array (optional)
  raw_flow/steps/*/impl_status: string (optional)
  Schema: [raw_flow](docs/product-truth/schemas/flow.schema.json)
  ac/id: string (required)
  ac/title: string (required)
  ac/level: null|string (optional)
  ac/work_status: null|string (optional)
  Schema: [ac](config/ac_store_schema.json)
Produces:
  SOURCE-REVIEWED DOCUMENTATION: Source-reviewed documentation of leafcutter-web/lib/data/types.ts, flow-contracts.ts and flows.ts; no runtime registration or automatic TypeScript/schema parity check.
  atlas_flow/steps/*/acs/*/id: string (required)
  atlas_flow/steps/*/acs/*/workStatus: string (required)
  atlas_flow/steps/*/acs/*/resolved: boolean (required)
  atlas_flow/steps/*/implStatus: string (required)
  atlas_flow/implSummary: object (required)
  Schema: [atlas_flow](docs/product-truth/schemas/atlas-normalized-flow.schema.json)

Input: stored references and fallback status — raw_flow; illustrative; selected fields only; full required/defaulted fields in linked contract:
{
  "id": "leafcutter/flow-render-pipeline",
  "component": "ux-prototyping",
  "kind": "data",
  "source": "real",
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "resolve",
      "implements": [
        "UXP-411"
      ],
      "impl_status": "done"
    }
  ]
}

Input: illustrative parsed YAML AC fields; not a status update — ac; illustrative; selected fields only; full required/defaulted fields in linked contract:
{
  "id": "UXP-411",
  "level": "L2",
  "work_status": "done"
}

Output: reconstructed resolved step projection — atlas_flow; reconstructed; selected fields only; full required/defaulted fields in linked contract:
{
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "resolve",
      "label": "Resolve live AC status",
      "implements": [
        "UXP-411"
      ],
      "implStatus": "done",
      "fallbackStatus": "done",
      "acs": [
        {
          "id": "UXP-411",
          "workStatus": "done",
          "resolved": true
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
